description: Replaces the contents of one existing PRIVATE draft on the authenticated account. The fields sent BECOME the draft rather than merging into it, so any field left out is dropped, including media. Posts nothing. Requires an authenticated X session behind the API key. Returns ok and the draft_tweet_id edited. Cost: $0.0016 per call. Docs: https://docs.twitterapis.com/docs/reference/write-actions/draft-edit

auth_token.description: Optional. The account's auth_token cookie; together with ct0, this call acts as that account. Sent out of band: as the x-auth-token request header on most endpoints, or inside the JSON request body on endpoints that take one. It is not sent as a query parameter, so it does not reach a URL or an access log.

ct0.description: Optional. The account's ct0 cookie, paired with auth_token. Same transport as auth_token: the x-ct0 request header, or the JSON body on a body-taking endpoint. It is not sent as a query parameter.

id.description: Numeric id of the draft to edit (its draft_tweet_id). Also accepted by the API as draft_tweet_id.

media_ids.description: Optional. Comma-separated media id(s) to attach. Omitting this drops whatever media the draft had; it is not merged.

proxy_url.description: Optional. Residential proxy URL this call egresses through. X soft-blocks writes from datacenter IPs as automated. Sent as the x-proxy-url request header, or in the JSON body on a body-taking endpoint.

quote.description: Optional. Numeric id of the tweet this draft quotes, as a string.

reply_to.description: Optional. Numeric id of the tweet this draft replies to, as a string.

text.description: The replacement draft body text. Required: an edit with no text is refused with 400.

user_agent.description: Optional. User-Agent string sent for this session. Sent as the x-user-agent request header, or in the JSON body on a body-taking endpoint.

name: twitter_draft_edit
